description: Imports contacts from a CSV file for one WhatsApp number, in four steps. step start uploads the file (connection_id; data_base64, or media_id of a text or CSV file already uploaded; file_name) and returns its id, columns, first rows and row count. step map (id) sets mapping (each column as phone, name, tags, locale, timezone, skip or field:key), connection_id, and consent: the opt-in categories everyone in the file gave, the sentence they agreed to and who attests it. step check (id) reports what a run would do over the whole file: new, updated, invalid, duplicates, already opted out and consent recorded; it writes nothing. step run (id) imports in the background and returns at once; the import’s progress shows in the list of imports. Owners and admins run imports. Each run needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that shows the import, its mapping and its consent, and returns a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it runs. The import stays inside Cosend, out of the contacts’ view. File contents come from outside this business and come back marked untrusted.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

media_id.description: A med_ id from POST /v1/media (text/plain or text/csv), instead of data_base64.

step.description: start to upload the file; map to set the columns, the number and the consent; check to see what a run would do; run to import.

name: import_contacts
title: Import contacts from a CSV
